dedupe_keys.name: canadian register of historic places crhp federal designations extract

description: The Canadian Register of Historic Places was developed by Parks Canada with the provinces and territories between the early 2000s and 2010 as a central listing of historic places designated at federal, provincial, territorial and municipal level. The open dataset is an extract from the register database taken on 12 December 2025, its most recent update, and holds the entries for federal heritage designations: site descriptions, heritage values and character-defining elements, with a separate terminology table. Coverage: Canada, federal designations only in the open extract; the HistoricPlaces.ca site remains online. Access: two XLSX files on the Open Government portal, free. Licence: Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: Parks Canada states the register is no longer actively maintained and may not reflect current designations; users are pointed to the designating jurisdiction and, for federal heritage, to the Directory of Federal Heritage Designations. Simulation uses are a list of designated heritage places with their valued elements for heritage exposure screening and adaptation planning. Related records: the NRHP spatial data for the United States and the Historic England listed buildings record.
